author: Faith Little
title: Water line break in Bristol, Tenn. impacting customers around Weaver Pike - NewsBreak
text:
By Faith Little No media credit provided. ,
1 days ago Photo: City of Bristol, TN BRISTOL, Tenn. (WJHL) — The City of Bristol, Tennessee said utility crews are on the scene of a water line break on Weaver Pike Tuesday afternoon, which is causing localized flooding under a bridge at Vance Tank Road.
According to a social media post by the city, the break is on Weaver Pike at Vance Tank Road, and customers in the Industrial Drive and Spring Valley Road areas are impacted.
The city said crews on scene estimated that it will take three hours to restore water service to impacted customers.
Drivers in the area are urged to use caution while work is being done.
The city said it will provide updates as they become available.
